name: dolphinscheduler-parse-object-lang
prompt: Add a class `ScheduleParamReader` in dolphinscheduler-api/src/main/java/org/apache/dolphinscheduler/api/dto/ScheduleParamReader.java with a static method `read(String json)` that turns a schedule's JSON text into a `ScheduleParam`.
